name: accept worse moves with a cooling probability
mechanism: propose a random neighbour; accept it if better, and if worse accept it with a probability that decreases with how much worse it is and with a temperature that is lowered over time, so early search roams and late search settles

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Simulated annealing' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms:

fails_when: schedule too fast freezes in a poor basin
